entities.summary: Abraham Coles was an American physician, translator, author and poet from New Jersey. He published Dies Irae (1859), Stabat Mater Dolorosa (1865), Stabat Mater Speciosa (1866), Old Gems in New Settings (1866), The Microcosm, The Evangel in Verse (1874) and The Light of the World (1884).
